purpose: Construir avatares image-first sin marcos rectangulares ni anatomía geométrica genérica.
important_ideas: One large avatar at a time for review.
Fewer strong alpha cutouts beat many weak collage pieces.
decisions: Mask may own head identity; torso must not be another face/mask.
Mirror/reuse one clean hand rather than add dirty sources.
